semantics.share: explicit owner duplication or unique-to-readonly-frozen conversion, never copy or lock
semantics.frozen: transitively immutable ordinary data; reject live mutable aliases
semantics.guard: RwLock guards authorize multiple readers or one writer, never both
semantics.actor: share does not imply Sendable, Serializable or cross-domain rights
semantics.failure: reject unsupported or unproven semantics before emitting guest

evidence_rule: Registry and source-only fixture checks are NOT executable compiler conformance. Record exact compiler SHA/tree, carrier blob parity, compiler execution, actual guest exit/output for positives, exact error+zero artifact for negatives, scheduler/race tests for guards and nonzero workflow steps. Unsupported is not PASS.

required_runtime_scenarios.name: concurrent_readers
required_runtime_scenarios.expect: many overlapping read guards on same protected object; no writer overlaps

required_runtime_scenarios.name: exclusive_writers
required_runtime_scenarios.expect: at most one write guard; no reader overlaps; no torn intermediate snapshots

required_runtime_scenarios.name: cancellation_waiter
required_runtime_scenarios.expect: cancelled lock waiter does not retain guard or block actor scheduler

required_runtime_scenarios.name: exceptional_release
required_runtime_scenarios.expect: guard releases exactly once on return/throw/raise/panic and supported cancellation

required_runtime_scenarios.name: owner_refcount_lifecycle
required_runtime_scenarios.expect: exact once drop, refcount overflow reject, no double release, cycle policy enforced

required_runtime_scenarios.name: isolate_boundary
required_runtime_scenarios.expect: unsupported worker/actor domains reject without host pointer or fake lock

required_runtime_scenarios.name: contention_progress
required_runtime_scenarios.expect: suspended lock acquisition does not block scheduler reactor progress or leak ownership
